content: Fabricated Metal Products• Flag of DEAhlen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany • 201-500 Employees. | Websites | winkelmann-group.comwinkelmann-group.de |. The Winkelmann Group is one of the leading companies in the field of metal forming. Automotive More than 100 years of know-how in metal forming technology with finesse in joining and painting, innovative potential in plastics technology and unconventional solutions in torsional vibration technology make up the business unit Automotive of the Winkelmann Group. Building + Industry Our products in the fields of heating, energy and plant engineering are state of the art thanks to our own research, development, cooperation with research institutes and production methods. Steel Services The Steel Services business unit has made a name for itself worldwide as an experienced and competent service provider in steel procurement and guarantees the disposition and just-in-time supply of flat steel products to the processing industry. Winkelmann Group is located in Ahlen, North Rhine-Westphalia, DE.

title: Company - Winkelmann Flowforming
content: **Winkelmann MSR Technology** GmbH, based in Ahlen (Germany), **STÖHR ARMATUREN** GmbH & Co. KG, based in Königsbrunn (Germany), **Wärmebehandlungen Magdeburg** GmbH (Germany), **K&H Zerspanung** GmbH as well as **LaserTeam** Gesellschaft für innovative Schweiss- und Schneidtechnik mbH, based in Gallin (Germany). **Winkelmann Flowform Technology** LP, based in Auburn, Alabama (USA), **Winkelmann Otomotiv Parçalari** San. ve Tic. Ltd. After all, we have decades of experience and know-how born of our passion for the production of complex formed products made from a diverse range of materials! And that’s why Winkelmann Flowforming is part of a global family business that was founded in 1898. Today, Winkelmann Group GmbH & Co. KG with its three divisions — Automotive, Building + Industry, and Flowforming — is one of the leaders in the field of metal forming in a wide range of industrial sectors. And we, at Winkelmann Flowforming, are a proud and ambitious part of the group. In addition to Ahlen and Auburn, we now have a third location in northeastern Turkey: Ergene in the province of Tekirdağ.
